name: FileTransferChannels
description: TauSync meeting-word identifiers for the file transfer protocol. Both PC and Android must call tau.connect() with the exact same string — define it here once and generate both sides.

members.name: REGULAR_FILE_METADATA
members.description: Metadata channel for a regular file transfer — carries JSON with the filename and byte-count before the data channel opens.

members.name: REGULAR_FILE_DATA
members.description: Data channel for a regular file transfer — carries raw file bytes, exactly the byte-count declared in the metadata channel.
